name: Google Gemini API
notes: Limits are model- and tier-specific; Google states RPM, input TPM and RPD are evaluated independently and RPD resets at midnight Pacific time.

name: Groq
notes: Free-plan limits are model-specific. Official documentation exposes RPM, RPD, TPM, TPD and audio limits; exact values can differ by model and account.

name: Cohere
notes: Trial keys are limited to 1,000 API calls/month. Chat trial rate limit is 20 requests/minute per model for the listed chat models; other endpoints have endpoint-specific limits.

name: OpenRouter
notes: OpenRouter states a free account gets 50 requests/day and 20 requests/minute for free models; adding at least $10 in credits raises the free-model daily ceiling to 1,000 while retaining 20 RPM.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
notes: Free allocation is 10,000 Neurons/day; allocation resets daily at 00:00 UTC.

name: Cloudflare Workers
notes: Workers Free allows 100,000 requests/day and resets at midnight UTC. This is a platform quota, not an AI-model quota.

name: GitHub API
notes: Unauthenticated REST requests are limited to 60/hour per originating IP. Authenticated user requests generally have a 5,000/hour primary limit; search and secondary limits are separate.

name: Mistral AI
notes: Mistral Free mode includes monthly usage, while requests/second and tokens/minute are model-specific and shown on the account Limits page.

name: Deepgram
notes: Current catalog evidence records $200 introductory credit; concurrency limits are product/plan-specific and should not be treated as a monthly request quota.

name: ElevenLabs
notes: Official pricing lists a $0 Free plan with 10,000 credits per month.

name: Brave Search API
notes: Current plan information records $5 in free API credits per month; credit-based allowance cannot be converted to requests without endpoint pricing.

name: AssemblyAI (speech-to-text)
notes: Current official pricing/FAQ evidence records $50 free API credits for supported usage; credits are consumed rather than reset on a monthly schedule.
